prompts.prompt: Correct the gait of this FRONT-FACING Major Bill walking sprite strip. Exactly SIX poses left-to-right with strict alternating gait, not six variations of one step. 1: SCREEN-LEFT boot forward/down, screen-right boot back/up, screen-right arm forward. 2: screen-left leg planted beneath torso, screen-right knee lifting. 3: both boots passing beneath hips. 4: SCREEN-RIGHT boot forward/down, screen-left boot back/up, screen-left arm forward. 5: screen-right leg planted, screen-left knee lifting. 6: both boots passing beneath hips, opposite arm position to frame3. Keep face/torso straight toward viewer, same stocky bearded officer and costume as reference, same size, head/collar stable, slight overhead view. Crisp pixel sprite, single row, wide gaps, complete limbs, transparent background, no text/shadows/scenery. 3:1 landscape.

Animation keyframes for Major Bill front view. THREE poses in ONE horizontal row, all full body. IMPORTANT all THREE have the boot on the LEFT SIDE OF THE IMAGE lower on the page and closer to the viewer than the boot on the right side of the image. This is the opposite step to reference. Pose1: LEFT-SIDE boot stretched toward viewer and planted, RIGHT-SIDE foot behind and lifted. Pose2: LEFT-SIDE leg supporting body, RIGHT-SIDE knee begins to swing forward. Pose3: LEFT-SIDE heel starts to lift while RIGHT-SIDE foot passes. Keep torso/face directly front-facing, same stocky brown-bearded charcoal/oxblood pressure-suited Major Bill as reference. Do NOT mirror face or chest: cyan indicator stays on image LEFT and four-button panel stays on image RIGHT. Consistent scale, neutral lighting, pixel art, transparent background, wide spacing, no text or shadow. Landscape 3:1.
